sentences.en: My fingers are stiff from playing the piano all day.
sentences.zh: 我弹了一整天钢琴，手指都僵硬了。

sentences.en: Pinocchio's legs were so stiff that he could not move them.
sentences.zh: 匹诺曹的腿僵硬得动不了。
